critical_code_review_comments: TournamentDetail.jsx: The `openBox === 'squads'` render branch is dead code without the accompanying SetupBox — this ships as a silent regression. Recommend a lint rule / test that every renderable openBox value has a matching SetupBox testId. This is the single-line miss that renders M28's biggest UX addition unreachable.

TournamentSquadsPanel.jsx uses N+1 API calls: one /participants + one /finance PER participant. For a 10-division tournament that's 11 sequential (well, Promise.all-parallel) calls. Consider a `?with_squad=true` query flag on /participants to fold it into a single response.

TournamentCreateModal.jsx line 165 useEffect deps: `[hostOptions, refsLoading, open]` — `form.host_body_id` is used inside but omitted; when the user manually picks a host and then persona changes (rare within one modal session, but possible), the auto-default runs incorrectly. Add form.host_body_id to deps or guard with a ref.

TournamentCreateModal.jsx line 87: initial state uses `season` from useSeason(), but the useEffect on line 102 resets form again with `{...emptyForm, fiscal_cycle: season}`. emptyForm.fiscal_cycle already reads window.__mpca_season || '2026-27' (line 65). Duplicate fallback logic; recommend removing the window global read now that useSeason() is the source of truth.

Backend routes/tournaments.py:341 imports resolve_participant_body_code inside the handler on every POST /squads call — safe but creates a repeated module import each request. Hoist the import to module top-level for a nano-optimisation and cleaner dep graph.

Squad.participant_body_code is Optional[str] — good. But there is no follow-on link back to tournament_participations to write squad_id (analogous to link_budget_to_participant). If MPCA's Squads panel needs to filter 'participants with squad started', the current implementation forces a client-side join. Consider adding link_squad_to_participant.

rca of the issue: Frontend bug — TournamentDetail.jsx was partially edited for M28: the import (TournamentSquadsPanel), the render conditional (`{openBox === 'squads' && <TournamentSquadsPanel .../>}`), and the accompanying `Users` icon import were all added correctly.
